fields.label: Your shops
fields.help: One per shop, like Allbirds|https://www.allbirds.com. Shopify and WooCommerce shops are searched; any other shop still works by pasting a product link.

fields.label: Results per shop
fields.help: How many products each shop shows per search. Eight by default.

fields.label: What Iris should know
fields.help: Your sizes, colours you like, brands you avoid, a budget. Iris keeps it in mind; nothing is sent to the shops.
